WorkBot

The assistant for the teams that keep a company running

WorkBot takes in the requests that operations, finance and support teams receive, keeps the company's policies where everyone can read them, and gives each team one place to work from.

Requests, from intake to done

A form any employee can use, a list the team works from, and a status on every request.

Policies in one place

The company's rules as plain documents, each owned by a team, readable by everyone.

One console for the teams

Operations, finance and support see their open work, by status and by priority, in one place.
